name: OpenStreetMap Overpass API
tagline: Query OpenStreetMap map data with a flexible Overpass QL language
description: The Overpass API is a read-only API that serves up custom selected parts of the OpenStreetMap map data. It is optimized for data consumers that need a few elements within a bounding box or matching certain tags, rather than bulk downloads of the whole planet.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public read-only endpoint; heavy use may be throttled or blocked by the public instance.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public instance; fair-use policy applies (no formal free-tier quota published as a fixed req/day number)
pricing.paid_plans: Self-host or use commercial Overpass providers; public instance has no paid plans

rate_limits: Main public instance fair-use: under ~10,000 queries/day and under ~1 GB download/day. Dynamic per-client slot throttling (often a small number, e.g. Rate limit: 2 on /api/status); cool-down after each query; HTTP 429 when no slot available. Timeout/maxsize also limit long queries.

example.response_snippet: {"version":0.6,"generator":"Overpass API","osm3s":{"timestamp_osm_base":"2026-...","copyright":"The data included in this document is from www.openstreetmap.org..."},"elements":[{"type":"node","id":123,"lat":48.85,"lon":2.29,"tags":{"amenity":"cafe","name":"Example"}}]}

use_cases: find amenities (cafes, hospitals) within a bounding box
get OSM ways/nodes matching tags near a point
export a small area of map features as GeoJSON-friendly JSON
query building footprints or roads in a region
check if a POI exists in OpenStreetMap by name/tag
